tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (body): a warm off-white, deep green-black in dark. Also the inset track behind .tab-row and code chips.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: modals, bottom sheets, inputs, stats tiles, the auth card, the install banner, the active tab. In dark it sits close to bg; borders, not shade, set surfaces apart.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Card-list rows (groups list, bill list, payment history) and nav-item hover: a faint tint of the accent green. Everything that isn't a list row stays on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-tint and accent-light (≥12:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: .muted captions, labels, notes, empty states, placeholders, idle icon buttons, chevrons. ≥7:1 on bg, surface, surface-tint and accent-light in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px outlines: card, tile and input borders, dividers, the active tab's outline, switch and slider tracks, the sheet grabber. ≥3:1 against bg, surface, surface-tint and accent-light, so controls and surfaces stand apart by their outline. Not a background behind text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The Spesa green: primary buttons, submit circles, active avatars, focus outline, bar fills, text selection, hover/pressed borders on rows. Label on it: on-accent, ≥7:1. As a focus ring or bar fill it is ≥4.5:1 on every surface and on its accent-light track.

tokens.name: accent-dark
tokens.usage: Accent as TEXT: links (.btn-link), secondary-button labels, the header wordmark, role tags, positive balances (the partner of negative), success messages. Inverts to a light mint in dark. ≥7:1 on bg, surface, surface-tint and accent-light.

tokens.name: accent-light
tokens.usage: Accent fills behind accent-dark text: secondary buttons, active chips, icon-button hover, pressed/keyboard-focused list rows, success messages, bar tracks.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Money going out, the partner of accent-dark's green for money coming in: "You owe" / "You borrowed" balances (.balance-negative), "You paid", spending up, over-budget values and bar fills. A true red, never used for errors (those are warn). ≥7:1 on bg, surface, surface-tint and accent-light in both themes.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Rust for errors and destructive actions: error text and the error message's border and icon, danger buttons, swipe-to-delete, destructive menu items, Sign out. Never for money — debts use negative. ≥7:1 as text on bg, surface, surface-tint, accent-light and warn-light; label on it: on-warn (8.8:1 light, 9.6:1 dark). At AAA lightness it can only sit ~7 (light) / ~5 (dark) OKLab ΔE×100 from negative, so errors are also marked by form: .status-error always carries the warning triangle and a box.

tokens.name: warn-light
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn text in .status-error (7.1:1 light, 8.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on accent fills (btn-primary, submit circles, active avatars, ::selection): white in light (7.1:1), near-black #0b1310 in dark (7.1:1). Never a literal white.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Label on warn fills (btn-danger, swipe-to-delete): white in light (8.8:1), near-black #0b1310 in dark (9.6:1). Never a literal white.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals (.modal-backdrop) and bottom sheets (.sheet-backdrop).

tokens.name: browser-bar
tokens.usage: The browser/status bar colour (<meta name="theme-color">): the brand green in light, the page's own near-black in dark, so a dark page never sits under a glaring green bar. index.html carries both as prefers-color-scheme metas for first paint; ThemeContext then sets them from this token for the theme actually shown, so an explicit Light/Dark in Settings wins over the OS.

tokens.name: category-1
tokens.usage: Category slot 1 — Groceries. The light value is also the preset hex saved on the category; painted via categoryColor() as var(--category-1). Category colours are data swatches (dots, pie slices, bars), never text, and always sit next to the category name. Default palette: ≥3:1 on bg/surface/surface-tint in both themes; any two ≥15 apart (OKLab ΔE×100, all pairs) for full colour vision, ~7 for colour-blind vision.

tokens.name: category-2
tokens.usage: Category slot 2 — Eating out. The light value is also the preset hex saved on the category; painted via categoryColor() as var(--category-2).

tokens.name: category-3
tokens.usage: Category slot 3 — Household. The light value is also the preset hex saved on the category; painted via categoryColor() as var(--category-3).

tokens.name: category-4
tokens.usage: Category slot 4 — Bills & utilities. The light value is also the preset hex saved on the category; painted via categoryColor() as var(--category-4).

tokens.name: category-5
tokens.usage: Category slot 5 — Transport. The light value is also the preset hex saved on the category; painted via categoryColor() as var(--category-5).

tokens.name: category-6
tokens.usage: Category slot 6 — Health. The light value is also the preset hex saved on the category; painted via categoryColor() as var(--category-6).

tokens.name: category-7
tokens.usage: Category slot 7 — Other (and uncategorized). The light value is also the preset hex saved on the category; painted via categoryColor() as var(--category-7).

tokens.name: category-cb-1
tokens.usage: Colour-blind palette, slot 1 (Groceries) — replaces category-1 when data-palette="colorblind" is on <html> (Settings > Layout, per device). Same colour families re-stepped in lightness: any two ≥8 apart under protanopia and deuteranopia (Machado 2009, all pairs), ~11 for full colour vision — hence opt-in. Slot 7 (Other) keeps category-7.

tokens.name: category-cb-2
tokens.usage: Colour-blind palette, slot 2 (Eating out) — replaces category-2 when data-palette="colorblind" is on <html> (Settings > Layout, per device).

tokens.name: category-cb-3
tokens.usage: Colour-blind palette, slot 3 (Household) — replaces category-3 when data-palette="colorblind" is on <html> (Settings > Layout, per device).

tokens.name: category-cb-4
tokens.usage: Colour-blind palette, slot 4 (Bills & utilities) — replaces category-4 when data-palette="colorblind" is on <html> (Settings > Layout, per device).

tokens.name: category-cb-5
tokens.usage: Colour-blind palette, slot 5 (Transport) — replaces category-5 when data-palette="colorblind" is on <html> (Settings > Layout, per device).

tokens.name: category-cb-6
tokens.usage: Colour-blind palette, slot 6 (Health) — replaces category-6 when data-palette="colorblind" is on <html> (Settings > Layout, per device).

styles.name: splash-mark
styles.usage: The single-letter app mark on the boot splash and favicon (on accent).

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The wordmark on the sign-in screen, in accent-dark.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One h1 per page (.page-title), with space-lg below.

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.usage: h2 in modals and bottom sheets.

styles.name: header-brand
styles.usage: The wordmark in the app header, in accent-dark.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: h2 section heads on Settings, Group Settings and Stats (.settings-section-title); a border hairline above every section after the first.

styles.name: month-divider
styles.usage: Month headers in the bill list, with a border hairline above.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: The figure in a stats-summary tile (16px in the slim variant).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Balance lines and default reading copy; inputs render at 16px to stop iOS zoom-on-focus.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: You're all settled up in this group.
styles.usage: Muted captions, empty states, status messages, sheet body copy, table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels (ink-soft), chips, the account chip (500).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row notes, field hints, table headers, bill status lines (italic).

styles.name: micro-caps
styles.usage: Uppercase label in slim stats tiles.

styles.name: day-divider
styles.usage: Day headers inside a month in the bill list, ink-soft. Uses the real Plex Mono 600 face (loaded since e3d8692; before that the browser faked it).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code / keys (.mono, code at 0.9em with a border chip).

text.note: The type scale as tokens, in rem so text follows the browser's own text-size setting (1rem = 16px by default; the app never sets a root size). Every font-size in the app is one of these (apart from em-relative code and one clamp() in the settle buttons).

tokens.name: text-2xs
tokens.usage: 11px: the header version tag, micro labels.

tokens.name: text-xs
tokens.usage: 12px: captions, row notes, field hints, table headers, day dividers.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: 13px: form labels, chips, the account chip.

tokens.name: text-md
tokens.usage: 14px: secondary text, muted captions, empty states, status messages, links.

tokens.name: text-base
tokens.usage: 15px: body copy, buttons, month dividers.

tokens.name: text-lg
tokens.usage: 16px: section heads, inputs (never smaller, or iOS zooms on focus).

tokens.name: text-xl
tokens.usage: 18px: sheet titles, the header wordmark.

tokens.name: text-2xl
tokens.usage: 20px: stat figures.

tokens.name: text-3xl
tokens.usage: 22px: page titles.

tokens.name: text-4xl
tokens.usage: 28px: the sign-in wordmark.

tokens.name: text-5xl
tokens.usage: 34px: the app mark's "S".

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: chip rows, label-to-hint. (Avatar rows use a deliberate 8px gap for a 44px tap pitch — not a spacing step.)

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Between card-list rows, status-message padding, gaps inside stats summaries.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Page side padding, stats-tile padding, gap between modal actions.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Below page titles and forms, sheet/modal padding, between sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, textareas, icon buttons, the active tab.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus and their items, the tab-row track, swipe-to-delete row shells, tip and preview boxes in Settings and the guide.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: THE radius: buttons, card-list rows, stats tiles, modals, status messages, the install banner.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The 64px app mark (favicon, boot splash).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The auth card and a bottom sheet's top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the account chip, bar tracks and fills, the sheet grabber. Avatars and submit circles use 50%.

zIndex.note: Stacking order, lowest to highest. Never a literal z-index.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky bars inside the page (the pagination bar).

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, the category colour picker, share status.

tokens.name: z-floating
tokens.usage: The install banner.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal and bottom-sheet backdrops.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare (borders set surfaces apart) and much stronger in dark, where 8% black vanishes on the near-black page.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: The active tab lifting off its track.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus and popovers (bill and row actions, invite and share menus, the category colour picker) and the sticky pagination bar.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: The floating install banner — the only element that floats over content.
